_note: Land mint/claim contracts (owner 2026-07-21). Free-mint currently active. Own the matching SIZE token → the size-specific distributor mintOne(tokenId,to)/mintMany(...) mints the LAND token free. tokenId = the ON-CHAIN parcel/estate id (see the tokenId-correction note below).

unclaimedSnapshot.note: unminted = snapshot tokenIds where ownerOf reverts

directSale.note: distributor mintOne/mintMany are nonpayable; native ETH/POL sale needs a new payable sale-minter per chain: buy(tokenId) → require(msg.value ≥ price[size]) → NFT.mint(buyer,tokenId) (MINTER_ROLE, granted by admin). ERC-721 duplicate guard = FCFS; coexists with free-claim.

tokenIdCorrection.problem: On-chain parcel tokenIds embed the parent estate's SIZE digit, NOT 6. e.g. 20912230228 = GIANT(2)·UW1(09)·#1223·#228. The snapshot in data/hexagon-city-source/l3/ still uses the OLD 6… scheme (parcelId===tokenId).
tokenIdCorrection.needed: The regenerated L3 snapshot (validated vs live ownerOf) with corrected `tokenId` + old value kept as `tokenIdOld` — pushed to this branch. Until then ownership/metadata/mint match on the WRONG id.

geometryGap: CGI + KOL zones have real on-chain estates but NO map geometry in the snapshot (map covers 10 zones). If in the sale, their shapes must be sourced separately.
